**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocker. This is a SAFETY-tier review, because the PR changes posted G-code.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4367#issuecomment-7219100341

## What looks good

- The change is small. Each post gets one flag, `tcpmLeft`, one copy in `endPreamble` and one `G49` in `onClose`.
- `endPreamble` copies `tcpmOn` after `afterOp()`. A trailing Go home writes its own `G49` and clears `tcpmOn`, so no second `G49` follows.
- `onClose` calls `endPreamble` first. A second call returns at `!sectionOpen`, so `tcpmLeft` keeps the value of the last section.
- The new `G49` is inside `if (!uprightAtEnd() && linesWritten() !== homedAt)`. The held-rotary exit and the Go home exit are unchanged.
- A later upright section writes `G49` in its preamble and sets `tcpmLeft` to false at its end. Thus no `G49` line appears without a `G43.4` before it.
- A program that never arms `G43.4` is byte-identical. `program_end::upright_program_end_adds_no_rotary_return` pins this.
- The decision record `docs/decisions/4348-g49-before-end-home.md` gives the choice, the reason and the dropped options.
- The body has `Changelog:`, "Goldens moved", "Not exercised" and ends with `Fixes #4348`. The commit subject is conventional.

## Paths that I read

I read `tilt()`, `onToolChange`, `startPreamble`, `afterOp`, `endPreamble`, `uprightAtEnd` and `onClose` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps`.

| Program end | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Last section tilts and ends at zero angles | `G91 G28 Z0` under `G43.4` | `G49`, then the retract |
| Last section holds a rotary off zero | `uprightAtEnd()` writes `G49` | same |
| Last section has a trailing Go home | `afterOp` writes `G49`, `onClose` writes no home | same |
| Last section is upright, after a tilted section | the preamble wrote `G49` | same, no new line |
| No tilt in the program | no `G49` line | same |

## Golden, line by line

`crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/fanuc/rotary.nc`: one line is added, `G49` at line 23. It is after `M5` and before `G91 G28 Z0`. The last `G43.4 H01` is at line 14, and no `G49` came after it before this change. No other line moved. This is the only recorded program in the diff (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/`), and the body lists it under "Goldens moved".

## Results, merged with main (local, trial merge with `upstream/main` `2cc90afd8`, clean)

- Pins: `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test upright_after_tilt`: 19 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: the plan has 234 steps on this main. I ran them in three parts.
  - `--only "post"`: 145 steps, 0 failed. This includes `script_fanuc`, `script_doosan_dnm`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `fanuc_post`, `setup_change` and `upright_after_tilt`.
  - `--only "app build"`: 1 step, 0 failed.
  - `--only "app suites"`: 88 steps, 0 failed. This includes `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `conformance`, `posting` and `after_op`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- Heavy lanes: not run. They are not a condition for a `P3` PR ("Heavy lanes at review"). The body records a green heavy run on this head.

## Mutations (my own, not the author's)

1. `fanuc.cps`: I removed the line `if (tcpmLeft) block(["G49"]);` in `onClose`.
   - `program_end::fanuc_cancels_tcpm_before_program_end_after_a_tilt_back_to_zero`: red ("G49 cancels G43.4 before the end retract").
   - `script_fanuc` `rotary`: red.
2. `doosan-dnm.cps`: I removed the line `tcpmLeft = tcpmOn;` in `endPreamble`.
   - `program_end::doosan_cancels_tcpm_before_program_end_after_a_tilt_back_to_zero`: red.

The other 17 tests of `upright_after_tilt` stayed green. I restored the two files with `git checkout`. The gate runs above are on the restored tree.

## Extra suites run

- Test data: the diff changes `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/fanuc/rotary.nc`. The suite that reads it is `script_fanuc` (11 passed). It ran in the quick gate.
- Importers: the diff does not touch import code. No kernel suite is owed.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Follow-ups (file after merge)

- `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:854-858`: the setup-change path of `afterOp` (a next setup with a stop ask) writes `G91 G28 Z0` while `tcpmOn` can be true. The Doosan post writes `G49` there (`doosan-dnm.cps:931`). The body names this under "Not exercised" and says that it needs an issue. No issue exists yet. Suggested priority: `P3`, `effort:high`, `area:post`.

## Notes (not blocking)

- No run on a real FANUC or Doosan control, as the body says.
- The PR changes no `crates/ui` code. No screenshot is necessary.
- The PR changes no process file.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
